area: Al Seef (also Festival City, Al Barsha, Expo City)
name: Al Fanar Restaurant & Café
questions: Which rice dishes (machboos, biryani) contain no wheat, vermicelli or stock cubes?
Is the grilled fish or meat dusted in flour?
Is the spice mix (bzar) blended in-house with no wheat?
summary: Michelin-listed Emirati chain; no gluten-free evidence found, and many Emirati staples are wheat-based, so ask first.
